purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt software system. It handles screen management and data entry for a receipt printing / public expense (Kouhi) entry order configuration screen (W122). It manages list display, selection, validation, and update of public expense entry order settings within the system administration subsystem.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese medical receipt software)

MCP (Message Control Program) style screen handling via MCP-STATUS / MCP-EVENT EVALUATE dispatch — typical of ORCA/GnuCOBOL GUI framework

verdict.notes: The file is decoded as latin-1 but the Japanese comments are actually multi-byte encoded (likely EUC-JP), causing mojibake in the latin-1 rendering. This is a production module from the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system used widely in Japanese clinics. The MCP framework is specific to ORCA/GnuCOBOL on Linux. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 84327 bytes (2090 lines total), but enough is visible to classify with high confidence.
